ask: Where should the length flag show, and how should we set each chapter's expected range?
problem: Partners want to know when a recording is far too short or too long. Mark chapter 2 was only 5 seconds, and nobody saw it.
found: The partner feed already gives the length of each recording. Nothing says what length is normal, so nothing can be flagged. Reference recordings give a real length for many chapters. Verse count gives only a rough guess.
changed: Nothing yet. I have not built anything. I am waiting for your answer.
why: Each option shows the same Mark 2 example. Reference audio is the most accurate range. Verse count works where no reference exists. Hand-set ranges are exact but take team time.
touches: Choosing the partner feed changes the partner guide. Choosing Reports adds a column to a report screen.

options.label: Partner feed only, range from reference recording
options.result: Partners see a flag in the feed. Reports stay as they are. Chapters with no reference get no flag.

options.label: Feed and Reports, reference recording first, then verse count
options.result: Partners and the team both see the flag. Every chapter gets a range, accurate where a reference exists.

options.label: Reports only, range from verse count
options.result: Only the team sees the flag. Ranges are rough everywhere.

options.label: Feed and Reports, team sets each range by hand
options.result: Exact ranges, but someone must enter them for every chapter.
